acme/widgets.title: Stale docs on route handlers
acme/widgets.body:
The docs for route handlers are out of date after the v5 release.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Open the docs page for route handlers
2. Compare it against `src/app/api/health/route.ts`

Expected behavior: examples use the new `context` argument.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Update `src/app/docs/route-handlers.md` with the new signature
- [ ] Add an example for the dynamic segment route
- [ ] Make sure the snippets compile

The doctest runner currently fails with:
    at compileExample (scripts/docs-check.ts:42:11)

acme/widgets.title: Clipboard paste loses formatting in Safari
acme/widgets.body:
Pasting rich text into the editor drops all formatting in Safari 18.

Repro steps:
1. Open the paste demo in Safari
2. Copy a table from a docs site
3. Paste - output is plain text only

Chrome and Firefox are fine. Suspect `packages/editor/src/paste/rich.ts` only handles the `text/html` type conditionally.

acme/widgets.title: Deeply nested config keys are ignored
acme/widgets.body: When a config key is nested more than three levels deep it silently vanishes after a round trip through the loader. I first noticed this while migrating a very large configuration file from our previous tool, and after some hours bisecting I narrowed it down to the merge step rather than the parse step, but I have not had time to dig further. The confusing part is that shallow keys survive fine, and the failure only shows up on write, so reads look normal until you reload the file. I tried a few workarounds with dotted aliases but those broke other things in ways that were hard to explain to my teammates, and eventually we agreed to keep the configuration shallow for now. The right fix probably belongs somewhere around the flattening logic, but a maintainer should confirm that before anyone starts moving code around. Reproduction requires a config with at least four nested sections and a reload cycle.

acme/widgets.title: Support .editorconfig in template expansion
acme/widgets.body:
Template expansion should honor .editorconfig indent settings so generated files match the host project.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Read indent style and size from .editorconfig
- [ ] Fall back to defaults when the file is absent

Entry points: `src/templates/expand.ts` and `src/templates/indent.ts`.

beta/kit.title: CLI: --json output misses the exit code field
beta/kit.body:
Machine-readable output drops the process exit code, so wrappers always report success.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Run `kit check --json` against a broken project
2. Inspect the JSON: no `exitCode` key

Expected behavior: the JSON document includes `exitCode` next to `status`.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Emit `exitCode` in `kit/cli/output.py`
- [ ] Cover it in the CLI tests
